notes.title: Welcome to "What Should I Eat Today"
notes.content:
Thanks for spending a dollar with us. We are a very small game studio called Fire and we're actually developing an RPG right now called Droidzone. This app helped me many times when my wife asked me: What should we have for dinner today? (She had no idea I was using this app)
When she found out, she almost divorced me. Not because I was using the app, but because I created that horrible randomizer button in which the gods of Random.Range will choose your ingredients and create... Well... You'll see.

This dollar you're throwing our way is helping a small indie develop an RPG - keep that in mind and I hope this app will save you many minutes trying to decide what should you eat today!

Let me know if you want to see something to make it better and I'll put in the work!

- Cheers, 
Fire Game Studios
